facts.raw_span: 74-year-old man
history of metastatic prostate cancer
known left upper lobe lung mass
four weeks of progressive vertigo
severe bifrontal throbbing headaches with nausea and vomiting
tested positive for adenovirus
temperature 37°C
heart rate 90 beats/min
3 cm left cerebellar hemispheric mass with surrounding vasogenic edema
cystic enhancing lesion in the left cerebellar hemisphere with mass effect
no other intra-axial lesions were identified
A hemangioblastoma was considered the leading diagnosis
